title: Shopping
description: Buy things, ask the price, and push back on it.

questions.sentence: Aa ketlanu che?
questions.correctAnswer: Aa pachas rupiya che.
questions.translatedSentence: This one is fifty rupees.

questions.sentence: Aa bahu monghu che.
questions.correctAnswer: This is very expensive.

questions.sentence: Keri no bhav shu che?
questions.correctAnswer: So rupiya kilo che.
questions.translatedSentence: They are a hundred rupees a kilo.

questions.sentence: Mare aa joie che.
options: I do not want this one.
questions.correctAnswer: I want this one.

questions.sentence: Tamari pase dudh che?
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, dudh che.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, we have milk.

questions.sentence: Aa dukan ma badhu sastu che.
options: Everything is cheap in this shop.
Everything is expensive in this shop.
Everything is new in this shop.
questions.correctAnswer: Everything is cheap in this shop.

questions.sentence: Tamne shu joie che?
questions.correctAnswer: Mane chaas joie che.
questions.translatedSentence: I would like some buttermilk.

questions.sentence: Tamari dukan bahu moti che.
questions.correctAnswer: Your shop is very big.

questions.sentence: Ketla rupiya thaya?
questions.correctAnswer: Pachas rupiya thaya.
questions.translatedSentence: That comes to fifty rupees.

questions.sentence: Bhai, tamari pase thepla che?
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, taja thepla che.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, we have fresh thepla.

questions.sentence: Mare ek kilo chokha joie che.
options: I need one kilo of rice.
I need one kilo of flour.
I need one kilo of sugar.
questions.correctAnswer: I need one kilo of rice.

questions.sentence: Tamne biju kai joie che?
options: Ha, mane thodu tel joie che.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, mane thodu tel joie che.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I need a little oil as well.

questions.sentence: Aa dhokla taja che ke nahi?
options: Are these dhokla fresh or not?
Are these dhokla sweet or not?
Are these dhokla expensive or not?
questions.correctAnswer: Are these dhokla fresh or not?

questions.sentence: Undhiyu kyare male che?
questions.correctAnswer: Undhiyu shiyala ma male che.
questions.translatedSentence: We have undhiyu in the winter.

questions.sentence: Mane thodu vadhare aapo.
questions.correctAnswer: Give me a little more.

questions.sentence: Aa shaak ketle rupiye kilo che?
questions.correctAnswer: Chalis rupiya kilo che.
questions.translatedSentence: It is forty rupees a kilo.

questions.sentence: Tamari dukan ketla vagye khule che?
options: What time does your shop open?
What time does your shop close?
How far away is your shop?
questions.correctAnswer: What time does your shop open?

questions.sentence: Tamari pase chaas che?
questions.correctAnswer: Na, chaas atyare nathi.
questions.translatedSentence: No, we do not have buttermilk right now.

questions.sentence: Aa saadi be so rupiya ni che.
options: Bahu monghi che, thodu ochu karo.
questions.correctAnswer: Bahu monghi che, thodu ochu karo.
questions.translatedSentence: That is very expensive, bring it down a little.

questions.sentence: Chhelli kimat kaho.
options: Tell me the name of the shop.
Tell me how much I paid.
questions.correctAnswer: Tell me your final price.

questions.sentence: Ochu nahi thay, bhai.
options: To hu biji dukan ma jais.
questions.correctAnswer: To hu biji dukan ma jais.
questions.translatedSentence: Then I will go to another shop.

questions.sentence: Pela dukan ma aa sastu male che.
options: It is cheaper at that other shop.
It is more expensive at that other shop.
It is not sold at that other shop.
questions.correctAnswer: It is cheaper at that other shop.

questions.sentence: Tame ketla aapsho?
questions.correctAnswer: Hu so rupiya aapish.
questions.translatedSentence: I will give a hundred rupees.

questions.sentence: Vees rupiya ocha karo to hu lais.
options: If you take twenty rupees off, I will buy it.
If you add twenty rupees, I will buy it.
Take twenty rupees and I will go.
questions.correctAnswer: If you take twenty rupees off, I will buy it.

questions.sentence: Aa bhav ma nahi male.
options: To thodu to ochu karo ne, bhai.
questions.correctAnswer: To thodu to ochu karo ne, bhai.
questions.translatedSentence: Then at least bring it down a bit, brother.

questions.sentence: Hu ahiya hammesha kharidi karu chu.
questions.correctAnswer: I always shop here.

questions.sentence: Tame juna gharak cho, etle hu so rupiya ocha karu chu.
questions.correctAnswer: Aabhar, to hu be lais.
questions.translatedSentence: Thank you, in that case I will take two.

questions.sentence: Tamne ketlu joie che?
questions.correctAnswer: Mane aadhu kilo joie che.
questions.translatedSentence: I need half a kilo.

questions.sentence: Aa shirt mane nanu pade che.
options: This shirt is too small for me.
This shirt is too big for me.
questions.correctAnswer: This shirt is too small for me.

questions.sentence: Aa moti size ma male che?
options: Ha, aa rang bahu saro che.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, moti size pan che.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, we have it in a bigger size too.

questions.sentence: Mane tran kilo khand joie che.
options: I need three kilos of sugar.
I need three kilos of flour.
I need three litres of milk.
questions.correctAnswer: I need three kilos of sugar.

questions.sentence: Aa jeans no number ketlo che?
options: Aa be so rupiya ni che.
questions.correctAnswer: Aa batrees number ni che.
questions.translatedSentence: These are a size thirty-two.

questions.sentence: Aa thelo bahu nano che, moto aapo.
options: This bag is too small, give me a bigger one.
This bag is too big, give me a smaller one.
This bag is torn, give me a new one.
questions.correctAnswer: This bag is too small, give me a bigger one.

questions.sentence: Dudh ketlu joie che?
questions.correctAnswer: Ek litre dudh aapo.
questions.translatedSentence: Give me one litre of milk.

questions.sentence: Aadha kilo thi vadhare nathi joitu.
options: I do not need more than half a kilo.
I need a little more than half a kilo.
Half a kilo is not going to be enough.
questions.correctAnswer: I do not need more than half a kilo.

questions.sentence: Aa pack ma ketla thepla che?
options: Aa pack ma das thepla che.
questions.correctAnswer: Aa pack ma das thepla che.
questions.translatedSentence: There are ten thepla in this pack.

questions.sentence: Badhu malin ketla thaya?
options: Badhu malin tran so rupiya thaya.
questions.correctAnswer: Badhu malin tran so rupiya thaya.
questions.translatedSentence: It comes to three hundred rupees altogether.

questions.sentence: Tamari pase chhutta paisa che?
options: Do you have a carry bag?
questions.correctAnswer: Do you have change?

questions.sentence: Tame rokad ma aapsho ke card thi?
options: Mane ek thelo pan joie che.
questions.correctAnswer: Hu card thi aapish.
questions.translatedSentence: I will pay by card.

questions.sentence: Mane bill aapsho?
options: Will you give me the bill?
Will you give me the change?
Will you give me a discount?
questions.correctAnswer: Will you give me the bill?

questions.sentence: Aa so rupiya ni note lo.
options: Bhav so rupiya thi ocho che.
questions.correctAnswer: Chhutta nathi, biji note aapo.
questions.translatedSentence: I do not have change, please give me another note.

questions.sentence: Aa tamara vees rupiya pachha lo.
options: Here, take your twenty rupees back.
Please give me twenty rupees more.
Keep the twenty rupees with you.
questions.correctAnswer: Here, take your twenty rupees back.

questions.sentence: Thelo joie che?
questions.correctAnswer: Na, mari pase thelo che.
questions.translatedSentence: No, I have a bag with me.

questions.sentence: Rasid sambhali ne rakho.
questions.correctAnswer: Keep the receipt safely.

questions.sentence: Ahiya online payment chale che?
options: Ha, thelo das rupiya no che.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, QR code ahiya che.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, the QR code is right here.

questions.sentence: Aa shirt faati gayu che, etle hu badli karava aavyo chu.
options: Rasid hoy to ame badli aapi deshu.
Bhav ochu karva mate kale aavo.
Aa shirt ni size bahu saras che.
questions.correctAnswer: Rasid hoy to ame badli aapi deshu.
questions.translatedSentence: If you have the receipt, we will exchange it for you.

questions.sentence: Me aa gai kale lidhu hatu, pan aa kharab nikalyu.
options: I bought this yesterday, but it turned out to be faulty.
I bought this yesterday, and it works perfectly.
I will buy this tomorrow if it is not faulty.
questions.correctAnswer: I bought this yesterday, but it turned out to be faulty.

questions.sentence: Tamne paisa pachha joie che ke biju kai?
options: Paisa pachha joie che, kem ke biju kai gamtu nathi.
Biju kai joie che, kem ke aa dukan moti che.
Paisa pachha nathi joita, kem ke rasid mari pase che.
questions.correctAnswer: Paisa pachha joie che, kem ke biju kai gamtu nathi.
questions.translatedSentence: I would like a refund, because I do not like anything else here.

questions.sentence: Jo aa size nano pade to hu kale badalva aavish.
options: If this size turns out too small, I will come tomorrow to exchange it.
If this size turns out too big, I will keep it anyway.
If this size fits me, I will come again tomorrow.
questions.correctAnswer: If this size turns out too small, I will come tomorrow to exchange it.

questions.sentence: Pela dukan ma aa sastu hatu, to tame ahiya kem lidhu?
options: Kem ke ahiya no maal saro che ane dukandar pan sara che.
Kem ke ahiya bhav bahu vadhare che ane maal juno che.
Kem ke mare atyare kai kharidvu nathi.
questions.correctAnswer: Kem ke ahiya no maal saro che ane dukandar pan sara che.
questions.translatedSentence: Because the goods here are good, and the shopkeeper is decent too.

questions.sentence: Ame Ahmedabad ma kharidi karie chie kem ke tya bhav ocha che.
options: We shop in Ahmedabad because the prices are lower there.
We shop in Ahmedabad even though the prices are higher there.
We want to shop in Ahmedabad, but the shops are closed.
questions.correctAnswer: We shop in Ahmedabad because the prices are lower there.

questions.sentence: Tamari fariyad shu che?
options: Me je magyu hatu te tame nathi aapyu.
Me tamne gai kale ahiya joya hata.
Mane tamari dukan bahu game che.
questions.correctAnswer: Me je magyu hatu te tame nathi aapyu.
questions.translatedSentence: You did not give me what I had asked for.

questions.sentence: Jo tamari pase rasid nahi hoy to ame paisa pachha nahi aapi shakie.
options: If you do not have the receipt, we cannot give you a refund.
If you have the receipt, we still cannot give you a refund.
We can give you a refund even without the receipt.
questions.correctAnswer: If you do not have the receipt, we cannot give you a refund.

questions.sentence: Hu tamne aana badle bijo shirt aapu, chalse?
options: Ha, chalse, pan aa var moti size aapjo.
Ha, chalse, pan mare paisa pachha joie che.
Na, nahi chale, kem ke aa shirt saras che.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, chalse, pan aa var moti size aapjo.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, that works, but this time give me a bigger size.
